periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, tilted approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial midline towards the ventral-medial plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid morphology with a vertical-to-horizontal aspect ratio greater than 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering with the lowest point extending well below the horizontal geometric center of the eye patch.
